title: GALLERY HOSTS
description: Welcome visitors into Cincinnati Art Week’s temporary galleries, learn about participating artists and help people discover what’s happening throughout the week.

form.title: Gallery Host Application
form.intro:
Welcome to the Gallery Host Application!

Role: Gallery Host Application
Dates: October 3–10, 2026 · Over-the-Rhine, Cincinnati
Pay: $17/hour · Approx. 25–35 hours · Paid orientation

Description:

Gallery Hosts are the welcoming face of Cincinnati Art Week’s temporary galleries throughout Over-the-Rhine. Hosts will greet visitors, learn about the artists and exhibitions in their assigned space, answer basic questions, support art sales, and help guests navigate and discover what’s happening across Cincinnati Art Week.

We’re looking for friendly, reliable and curious people who enjoy connecting with others and can help create a warm, welcoming experience. _Experience in arts, events, hospitality or customer service is a plus, but no arts experience is required._

form.title: CAW Artist Submission
form.intro:
Hello! Thanks for reaching out to Cincinnati Art Week.

Have an idea? Want to share an art happening or experience you're already planning? Has Cincinnati Art Week inspired an idea you'd want to activate? We'd love to connect!

PLEASE READ

This year Cincinnati Art Week will take place in the neighborhood of Over-the-Rhine from October 3-10. We are activating storefronts, showcasing independent artists, and hosting programming & creative gatherings.

Cincinnati Art Week believes it's merrier with more and good ideas like company.

In this spirit, we want to facilitate as much artistic activity, highlight as many local and emerging artists, and create a welcoming atmosphere. Project funds are not currently available. We would love to get to know you, explore ideas, matchmake where possible, provide visibility if helpful, and generally see how we can support making great ideas possible.
